verses.1: All souls must submit to the powers of God; for no power exists without the will of God. And those powers that do exist are indeed those that are subject to God’s will.
verses.2: So that those who resist the authority decreed by God will be punished. And those who do resist will bring punishment upon themselves.
verses.3: For those who are in positions of power, there is no fear of good deeds, but only of evil ones. Do you not want to be afraid of power? Good deeds bring praise and rewards from those who do them.
verses.4: For you are indeed a servant of God, and your duty is to do what is good. But if you do evil, then be afraid! You must not act recklessly. For you are a servant of God; you must judge with justice when doing evil.
verses.5: Therefore, it was necessary to make a decision, not only out of anger, but also out of common sense.
verses.6: For this reason, taxes should also be abolished. After all, officials are simply instruments used by God to carry out His purposes.
verses.7: Pay all debts to everyone, to the one who pays the tax, to the one who fulfills his obligations, to the one who fears God, and to the one who deserves respect.
verses.8: Don’t lose anything, if you don’t love each other. For indeed, loving one another is the law that completes everything.
verses.9: For you will not commit adultery, you will not kill, you will not steal, and you will not desire anything else. And if anyone gives you another commandment, it will be contrary to these principles. You must love your neighbor as yourself.
verses.10: Love does not act harmfully when it is present nearby. Therefore, love is a complete embodiment of the law.
verses.11: And since you know that it’s already time for you to wake up from your sleep, it’s now more important than ever for us to be saved.
verses.12: The night began to fall, while the day continued. We then put aside our tools of darkness, and put on our weapons of light.
verses.13: Let us walk through the day in a pleasant manner, without anger or hatred, without envy or jealousy.
verses.14: But you should wear the robe of Lord Jesus Christ. And do not act in a way that is motivated by fleshly desires.
